{{short description|American mathematician}}
'''Rachel Roberts''' is an American mathematician specializing in [[low-dimensional topology]], including [[foliation]]s and [[contact geometry]]. She is the Elinor Anheuser Professor of Mathematics at [[Washington University in St. Louis]].{{r|wustl}}

Roberts completed her Ph.D. at [[Cornell University]] in 1992. Her dissertation, supervised by [[Allen Hatcher]], was ''Constructing Taut Foliations''.{{r|mg|cmd}} She was elected to the 2026 class of Fellows of the [[American Mathematical Society]].{{r|fams}}

* {{cite journal | title=Infinitely many hyperbolic 3-manifolds which contain no Reebless foliation|last1=Roberts | first1=Rachel | last2=Shareshian | first2=John | last3=Stein | first3=Melanie | journal=[[Journal of the American Mathematical Society]] | volume=16 | issue=3 | year=2003 |  doi=10.1090/s0894-0347-03-00426-0 | pages=639–680 | mr=1969207| doi-access=free }}
